hints.title: Identifying Candidate Drops
hints.text: Every index where number matches the given digit represents a valid candidate string after deletion.

hints.title: Greedy Advantage Condition
hints.text: Removing digit immediately before a strictly larger adjacent digit yields an immediate lexicographical increase.

hints.title: Fallback to Rightmost Occurrence
hints.text: If no occurrence is followed by a larger digit, removing the last occurrence of digit minimizes loss.

hints.title: Optimal Substring Selection Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear scan over digits followed by string slice.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all deletions takes O(n^2), which works for small strings but is redundant.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Slicing produces a new string of length n - 1.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate explains why the first occurrence followed by a greater digit is strictly optimal.
